checks.note: The agent role is revoked everything and then granted only SELECT and INSERT on audit_events. It has no UPDATE, DELETE or TRUNCATE, and no grant of *. No WORM or Object Lock exists, but the DB grants block rewriting by the agent role.

None of the agent's tools or listed ERP operations touch audit records, and there is no DB-admin, log or storage tool. But erp_call forwards any operation name the ERP exposes, and the ERP server's operation set is outside this repo. Whether any operation could alter audit records cannot be proven here.

The vendor's payment_id is stored in the tool_result row, which carries operation_id and the identity fields. However the payments and ERP calls send no trace context or instance id. Payments sends only an idempotency key, and ERP _meta carries only business_unit and run_id. A failed or timed-out call stores no vendor ID. The gateway-side and vendor-side mapping is outside this repo.
